Español

Destinos Principales en España

Guías de trenes claras, itinerarios día por día, consejos de barrios y el directorio completo con los 8,124 municipios y ciudades de España.

Community of Madrid · 3–4 days

Madrid (Madrid)

Prado & Reina Sofía art triangle, Retiro Park, lively tapas crawls in La Latina and radial AVE day trips.

Catalonia · 3–5 days

Barcelona (Barcelona)

Gaudí's Sagrada Família and Modernisme icons, Gothic Quarter lanes, Mediterranean beaches and Catalan dining.

Andalusia · 3–4 days

Seville (Sevilla)

Mudéjar Real Alcázar palaces, Gothic Cathedral, orange-blossom plazas, Triana ceramics and flamenco.

Andalusia · 2–3 days

Granada (Granada)

Nasrid Palaces of the Alhambra, whitewashed Albaicín viewpoints, Sierra Nevada backdrop and free-tapa bars.

Valencian Community · 2–3 days

Valencia (València)

Turia Riverbed gardens, futuristic City of Arts and Sciences, Central Market and authentic paella by the sea.

Basque Country · 3–4 days

San Sebastián & Bilbao (Donostia · Bilbao)

La Concha bay promenade, Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Michelin gastronomy and Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum.

Andalusia · 1–2 days

Córdoba (Córdoba)

The striped arches of the Mezquita-Catedral, flower-filled Jewish Quarter patios and Roman Bridge.

Balearic Islands · 3–5 days

Mallorca (Palma & Serra de Tramuntana) (Mallorca)

Gothic Palma Cathedral, Sóller vintage wooden train, limestone mountain villages and turquoise coves.

Galicia · 2–3 days

Santiago de Compostela & Rías Baixas (Santiago de Compostela)

Granite arcades of the Camino finale, Portico of Glory, fresh Atlantic seafood and Albariño vineyards.

Castilla-La Mancha · 1–2 days

Toledo & Segovia (Toledo · Segovia)

Three-culture hilltop Toledo and Segovia's Roman Aqueduct & Alcázar — effortless 30-minute AVE trips from Madrid.
